## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      7 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 4, 2026 - Sep 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Twig n Berries_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for the premium account. Each time I try to use the barcode scanner, it tells me I need to upgrade to premium. When I click on “okay” it tells me I’m already subscribed…. Endless loop. Complete ripoff."
            2. _cameronstarrenergy_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a paid user for years but recently the app shows that I am not a paid user with ads popping up. When I go to upgrade it says I am already a subscriber. I have had to delete the app and restart it in order for it to work again but it doesn’t last. Please fix this."
            3. _TerriJo_, Sep 6, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve subscribed to MyFitnessPal Premium intermittently for years, and I’ve always come back because the core tracking tools are solid. But this time has been incredibly frustrating.I purchased MFP Premium in February 2026 and the subscription still shows as active in my Apple Subscriptions list. Despite that, the app refuses to recognize it — Premium features are locked, Restore Purchase is missing, and Manage Subscription doesn’t appear anywhere.I contacted MyFitnessPal support about this problem back in May, provided screenshots, and followed every step they suggested. Months later, nothing has been resolved. Apple says the issue is with the app, and the app says nothing helpful at all.After years of being a paying customer, it’s disappointing to hit a subscription entitlement failure that neither Apple nor MFP seems willing or able to fix. I hope the developers take this seriously, because long‑time users shouldn’t have to fight this hard just to access a subscription they already paid for."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Sep 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _cheezeluvr77_, Sep 9, 2026, 1/5: "The app was working an hour ago and now I can't even log in. It's saying account not found. I was paying for premium too. Also several MFP "help" links make you log in to send a message so I have zero way of fixing the issue"
            2. _Red Sox Mania_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "They ruined everything that was good about the app. It’s unusable. Really sad they let AI code and manage support and tell them what people like. I’m sure soon enough they will announce it’s shutting down."
            3. _Verczeska_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
<!--/ir-theme-->
